pm-kisan_benefits: ₹6,000 annually credited directly into bank accounts in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
pmay-g_benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/hilly states + 90 days MGNREGA unskilled labor wages.
pmjay-ayushman_benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for inpatient medical treatment across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals.
pm-ujjwala_desc: Free LPG gas connection with first refill and stove free for adult women from low-income rural households.
pm-ujjwala_benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection + Free hotplate (stove) + First 14.2kg LPG cylinder refill + ₹300 subsidy per cylinder.
sukanya-samriddhi_desc: High-interest government savings scheme for girl children offering tax benefits and guaranteed returns for higher education & marriage.
sukanya-samriddhi_benefits: Interest rate of 8.2% p.a. tax-free under Section 80C. Deposits from ₹250 to ₹1.5 Lakh per year.
nsap-old-age-pension_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
nsap-old-age-pension_desc: Monthly pension support for senior citizens aged 60+ living below poverty line in rural & urban India.
nsap-old-age-pension_benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month (combined Central + State contribution) credited to bank account.
pm-vishwakarma_desc: Holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople including toolkit incentives, skill training, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh.
pm-vishwakarma_benefits: ₹15,000 Toolkit Incentive + ₹500/day stipend during training + Collateral-free loan of ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1) & ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2) at 5% interest.
pm-mudra_desc: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹10 Lakhs for micro-enterprises, small businesses, shopkeepers, and self-employed entrepreneurs.
pm-mudra_benefits: Collateral-free business loans under 3 categories: Shishu (Up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh).
pm-svanidhi_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
pm-svanidhi_desc: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors.
pm-svanidhi_benefits: First tranche working capital loan of ₹10,000 (7% interest subsidy), 2nd tranche ₹20,000, 3rd tranche ₹50,000 + cashback on digital transactions.
mgnrega_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
mgnrega_desc: Guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
mgnrega_benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per rural household per year at statutory state wage rates (avg ₹240-₹375/day).
post-matric-scholarship_desc: Financial assistance for post-secondary/higher education students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories.
post-matric-scholarship_benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year directly to student accounts.
tn-pudhumai-penn_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance (Pudhumai Penn - Tamil Nadu)
tn-pudhumai-penn_desc: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 for female students from Govt schools pursuing higher education in Tamil Nadu.
tn-pudhumai-penn_benefits: ₹1,000 every month directly transferred to bank accounts until completion of UG Degree, Diploma, ITI, or Professional course.
up-kanya-sumangala_name: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
up-kanya-sumangala_desc: Phased financial incentive total ₹25,000 for girl child from birth through education stages in Uttar Pradesh.
up-kanya-sumangala_benefits: Total ₹25,000 distributed in 6 installments from birth (₹5,000), vaccination, Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, and Degree/Diploma entry.
telangana-rythu-bandhu_desc: Crop investment support of ₹10,000 per acre per year for landholding farmers in Telangana for purchase of seeds, fertilizers & inputs.
telangana-rythu-bandhu_benefits: ₹5,000 per acre per season (Rabi and Kharif), total ₹10,000 per acre per year credited directly to Pattadar bank accounts.
karnataka-gruha-lakshmi_desc: Monthly financial aid of ₹2,000 to the woman head of every eligible household in Karnataka.
karnataka-gruha-lakshmi_benefits: ₹2,000 per month directly deposited to the bank account of the designated female head of the family.
igndps-disability-pension_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
igndps-disability-pension_desc: Monthly pension assistance for individuals aged 18-79 living below poverty line with severe (80%+) disability.
igndps-disability-pension_benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 credited directly into bank account.
pm-fasal-bima_benefits: Full coverage of sum insured for crop loss due to natural calamities. Farmers pay 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
atal-pension-yojana_desc: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers guaranteeing fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60.
atal-pension-yojana_benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000 / ₹4,000 / ₹5,000 depending on contribution amount and age of entry. Government co-contributes 50% for eligible subscribers.
pm-jan-dhan_desc: Financial inclusion mission to provide universal access to basic banking, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension facilities for the unbanked.
pm-jan-dhan_benefits: Free zero-balance savings account + RuPay debit card + ₹2 Lakh accident insurance + ₹30,000 life cover + ₹10,000 overdraft facility after 6 months.
startup-india-seed-fund_desc: Financial assistance of up to ₹20 Lakh (PoC grant) and up to ₹50 Lakh (investment at convertible debenture) for early-stage Indian startups.
startup-india-seed-fund_benefits: Grant of up to ₹20 Lakh for PoC/prototype, and investment up to ₹50 Lakh for market entry & commercialization via empanelled incubators.
pm-garib-kalyan-anna_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
pm-garib-kalyan-anna_desc: Free food grain distribution scheme providing 5 kg of wheat/rice per person per month to 81 Crore National Food Security Act beneficiaries.
pm-garib-kalyan-anna_benefits: 5 kg free food grain (wheat/rice) per person per month through Ration Card at Fair Price Shops under NFSA.
udid-disability-scheme_name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) & Divyangjan Welfare Schemes
udid-disability-scheme_desc: Centralized disability registration and ID card scheme enabling Divyangjan to access all disability benefits, concessions, and welfare schemes seamlessly.
udid-disability-scheme_benefits: UDID Card enables: 3% reservation in govt jobs, 5% reservation in govt housing, income tax benefits (₹75,000 - ₹1,25,000 deduction under Sec 80U), free railway travel concession, and free/subsidized assistive devices.
edu-tn-tamil-puthalvan_desc: ₹1,000 per month for male college students who completed schooling in TN government schools.
edu-tn-tamil-puthalvan_benefits: ₹1,000 monthly direct bank transfer for the duration of collegiate course.
edu-tn-first-graduate_name: Tamil Nadu First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession
edu-tn-first-graduate_desc: Tuition fee waiver up to ₹25,000 per year for first-generation degree students in engineering and arts colleges.
edu-tn-first-graduate_benefits: Tuition fee waiver up to ₹25,000 per year directly adjusted in government counseling fee.
edu-nsp-merit-means_desc: ₹12,000 per year to prevent school dropouts after Class 8 for students with family income under ₹3.5 Lakh.
edu-nsp-merit-means_benefits: ₹12,000 per academic year directly paid into Aadhaar-linked savings account.
edu-pm-usp-central-sector_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP)
edu-pm-usp-central-sector_desc: ₹12,000/year for UG and ₹20,000/year for PG studies for meritorious college students.
edu-pm-usp-central-sector_benefits: ₹12,000 annually for first 3 years of UG; ₹20,000 annually for PG degree.
edu-aicte-pragati_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
edu-aicte-pragati_desc: ₹50,000 per year for female engineering and technical diploma students.
edu-aicte-pragati_benefits: ₹50,000 per year for every year of technical course duration.
edu-aicte-saksham_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
edu-aicte-saksham_desc: ₹50,000 annually for technical and engineering students with registered disability.
edu-aicte-saksham_benefits: ₹50,000 per year towards tuition, books, and assistive devices.
edu-tn-bc-mbc-scholarship_desc: Tuition and maintenance grant for BC/MBC students in Tamil Nadu with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh.
edu-tn-bc-mbc-scholarship_benefits: Tuition fee waiver and maintenance allowance up to ₹10,000 per year.
edu-national-fellowship-obc_desc: Monthly fellowship up to ₹35,000 + HRA for OBC doctoral and research scholars.
edu-tn-free-education-degree_name: Tamil Nadu Free Education Scheme for Undergraduates
edu-tn-free-education-degree_desc: Free college tuition for undergraduate courses in government arts & science colleges.
edu-tn-free-education-degree_benefits: 100% waiver of special fees and tuition fees in government arts & science colleges.
edu-pm-vidyalaxmi-education-loan_desc: Collateral-free higher education loans up to ₹7.5 Lakh with 3% interest subsidy for family income under ₹8 Lakh.
edu-pm-vidyalaxmi-education-loan_benefit: Up to ₹7.5 Lakh collateral-free loan with 3% interest subsidy during moratorium period.
agri-pm-kusum-solar-pump_desc: 60% subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for standalone solar water pumping systems.
agri-pm-kusum-solar-pump_benefits: Up to 60% capital subsidy for installing 3HP to 10HP solar powered water pumps.
agri-kisan-credit-card_desc: Crop loan up to ₹3 Lakh at 4% interest rate with 3% prompt repayment incentive.
agri-kisan-credit-card_benefits: Collateral-free agricultural loan up to ₹1.6 Lakh and low interest loan up to ₹3 Lakh at 4% effective interest.
agri-tn-kuruvai-cultivation-package_name: Tamil Nadu Kuruvai Cultivation Special Package
agri-tn-kuruvai-cultivation-package_desc: 100% subsidy on certified paddy seeds, urea, DAP, and potash kits for Cauvery delta farmers.
agri-tn-kuruvai-cultivation-package_bene: Free fertilizer and seed inputs worth ₹4,000 per acre (up to maximum 1 acre per farmer).
agri-pm-krishi-sinchayee-micro-irrigatio: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop
Up to 100% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 75% for other farmers for drip irrigation.
100% capital subsidy on drip/sprinkler equipment for small & marginal farmers in Tamil Nadu.
agri-soil-health-card_desc: Free soil testing and report cards every 3 years with precise fertilizer dosing advice.
agri-soil-health-card_benefits: Comprehensive 12-parameter soil test report and tailored nutrient guidance completely free of charge.
agri-pm-matsya-sampada-fisheries_desc: 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women and 40% for general fishers to purchase fishing nets, boats, and build biofloc units.
agri-pm-matsya-sampada-fisheries_benefit: Financial grant up to ₹3,00,000 for individual aquaculture pond / modern fishing equipment.
health-tn-cmchis-insurance_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS - Tamil Nadu)
health-tn-cmchis-insurance_desc: ₹5 Lakh annual health coverage for Tamil Nadu families with annual income under ₹1,20,000.
health-tn-cmchis-insurance_benefits: ₹5 Lakh annual cashless treatment, diagnostic procedures, and follow-up medications.
health-pm-matru-vandana_desc: Direct cash benefit up to ₹6,000 to compensate wage loss and ensure institutional nutrition during childbirth.
health-pm-matru-vandana_benefits: Direct bank transfer of ₹5,000 in two installments (or ₹6,000 for second girl child).
health-tn-muthulakshmi-reddy-maternity_n: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
health-tn-muthulakshmi-reddy-maternity_d: ₹18,000 total maternal assistance including nutrition kits for pregnant women living in poverty in Tamil Nadu.
health-tn-muthulakshmi-reddy-maternity_b: ₹14,000 cash credited directly to bank account in 5 installments plus 2 nutrition kits valued at ₹4,000.
health-pm-bjp-jan-aushadhi_desc: Quality generic medicines at 50-90% lower prices through 10,000+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
health-pm-bjp-jan-aushadhi_benefits: Direct cost savings of 50-90% across 2,000+ generic medicines and surgical items.
health-nikshay-poshan-tb_name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (Nutritional Support for TB Patients)
health-nikshay-poshan-tb_desc: Monthly direct cash transfer for nutritional support throughout active TB treatment.
health-nikshay-poshan-tb_benefits: ₹500 to ₹1,000 monthly bank transfer throughout course of treatment (minimum 6 months).
health-tn-innuyir-kaappon-nammai-kakkum-: Innuyir Kaappom - Nammai Kaakkum 48 (Emergency Road Accident Care)
Free emergency treatment up to ₹1 Lakh in first 48 hours for road traffic accident victims, regardless of state/nation.
Emergency treatment coverage up to ₹1,00,000 per victim across 81 designated procedures.
health-pm-national-dialysis-programme_de: 100% free life-saving dialysis treatment at government district hospitals for BPL families.
health-pm-national-dialysis-programme_be: Free dialysis sessions, dialysis consumables, and nephrology consultation.
house-pmay-urban-2_desc: Interest subsidy up to ₹1.80 Lakh and direct construction aid of ₹2.5 Lakh for urban households without a pucca house.
house-pmay-urban-2_benefits: Direct subsidy of ₹2.5 Lakh for Beneficiary-Led Construction or 4% interest subsidy on housing loans.
house-tn-kalaignar-kanavu-illam_desc: ₹3.5 Lakh grant per family to reconstruct huts into modern pucca houses in rural villages of Tamil Nadu.
house-tn-kalaignar-kanavu-illam_benefits: Direct unit cost assistance of ₹3,50,000 per house credited in construction-linked stages.
house-tn-urban-habitat-slum-clearance_na: Tamil Nadu Urban Habitat Development Board Housing Allotment
house-tn-urban-habitat-slum-clearance_de: Subsidized permanent flats in urban multi-storey tenements for low-income urban families.
house-tn-urban-habitat-slum-clearance_be: Permanent alloted multi-storey flat with heavy capital subsidy; beneficiary pays minimal contribution.
house-swachh-bharat-ग्रामीण-toilet_name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) Individual Household Latrine (IHHL)
house-swachh-bharat-ग्रामीण-toilet_desc: ₹12,000 cash grant to construct an individual household latrine in rural residences.
house-swachh-bharat-ग्रामीण-toilet_benef: ₹12,000 incentive paid upon toilet completion and photograph verification.
house-pm-surya-ghar-solar-rooftop_name: PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
house-pm-surya-ghar-solar-rooftop_desc: Up to ₹78,000 direct subsidy for residential rooftop solar installation plus 300 units free electricity every month.
house-pm-surya-ghar-solar-rooftop_benefi: Subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1kW, ₹60,000 for 2kW, and ₹78,000 for 3kW or higher systems.
emp-tn-unemployed-youth-allowance_name: Tamil Nadu Unemployment Allowance for Job Seekers
emp-tn-unemployed-youth-allowance_desc: Monthly stipend up to ₹1,000 for educated unemployed youth registered with District Employment Exchange.
emp-tn-unemployed-youth-allowance_benefi: Monthly assistance: SSLC (₹200), HSC (₹300), Graduate/PG (₹600), Differently Abled (up to ₹1,000/month).
emp-pradhan-mantri-kaushal-vikas-4_desc: 100% free skill certification with placement assistance in AI, robotics, drones, logistics, healthcare, and green skills.
emp-pradhan-mantri-kaushal-vikas-4_benef: Free complete training, toolkits, assessment fee waiver, and government recognized National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) certificate.
emp-tn-naan-mudhalvan_desc: Free dynamic skill enhancement and job placement platform for over 10 lakh Tamil Nadu youth annually.
emp-tn-naan-mudhalvan_benefits: Free access to global certifications, hackathons, Cambridge English training, and campus placement drives.
emp-national-apprenticeship-promotion-na: On-the-job apprenticeship with monthly government-supported stipend and industrial certification.
Monthly stipend up to ₹10,000 (with ₹1,500 direct DBT government contribution) + national apprenticeship certificate.
wc-tn-moovalur-ramamirtham-marriage-aid_: Tamil Nadu Marriage Assistance Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Marriage Grant)
Up to ₹50,000 cash grant + 8g Gold Coin for poor brides from low-income families in Tamil Nadu.
₹25,000 for 10th pass or ₹50,000 for degree holders + 1 Sovereign (8 grams) 22ct Gold Coin.
wc-tn-kalaignar-magalir-urimai-thogai_de: ₹1,000 per month unconditional cash transfer honoring women's unpaid care work across Tamil Nadu.
wc-tn-kalaignar-magalir-urimai-thogai_be: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 annually) transferred on the 15th of every month into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
wc-beti-bachao-beti-padhao_desc: District-level scholarship, medical safety, and educational retention support for girl children.
wc-beti-bachao-beti-padhao_benefits: Direct educational kits, zero school dropout monitoring, and specialized district skill vouchers.
wc-mission-vatsalya-child-protection_nam: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection and Sponsorship Scheme)
wc-mission-vatsalya-child-protection_des: ₹4,000 per month family sponsorship for children without parental care or living in acute distress.
wc-mission-vatsalya-child-protection_ben: ₹4,000 per month credited directly to the joint bank account of child and guardian until age 18.
wc-tn-sivagami-ammaiyar-girl-child-prote: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme (Sivagami Ammaiyar Scheme)
₹50,000 fixed deposit in the name of the girl child to promote small family norms and eliminate female infanticide.
₹50,000 initial bond deposit maturing to over ₹2.5 Lakh for higher education at age 18 + annual incentive.
GOV-ENT-001_desc: Credit-linked subsidy programme aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
GOV-ENT-001_benefits: Government subsidy up to 35% of project cost in rural areas (25% in urban areas) for special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Ex-servicemen/PH). Bank finance up to 90-95% of project cost. Maximum project cost ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing sector and ₹20 Lakhs for service sector
GOV-ENT-002_desc: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
GOV-ENT-002_benefits: Bank composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore. Margin money support up to 15% under convergence schemes. Handholding support through Lead District Managers (LDM) and SIDBI
GOV-ENT-004_name: Tamil Nadu New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
GOV-ENT-004_desc: Flagship Tamil Nadu state government scheme assisting educated youth to become first-generation entrepreneurs by providing capital subsidy and interest subvention for setting up manufacturing and service enterprises.
GOV-ENT-004_benefits: 25% capital subsidy on project cost with a ceiling of ₹75 Lakhs. 3% interest subvention for the entire loan repayment tenure. State-sponsored Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training. Eligible project costs from ₹10 Lakhs up to ₹5 Crores
GOV-ENT-005_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PM FME)
GOV-ENT-005_desc: Centrally sponsored scheme designed to enhance the competitiveness of existing individual micro-enterprises in the unorganized food processing sector and support Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), SHGs, and producer cooperatives.
GOV-ENT-005_benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakhs per micro food processing unit. Seed capital of ₹40,000 per member of SHG for working capital and small tools. Support for common infrastructure and branding/marketing
GOV-FIN-001_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
GOV-FIN-001_desc: One-year life insurance scheme renewable from year to year offering life cover for death due to any reason at an extremely affordable premium of ₹436 per annum.
GOV-FIN-001_benefits: ₹2,00,000 death benefit payable to nominee in case of death of the insured member due to any cause. Extremely affordable premium of ₹436 per annum auto-debited from bank/post office savings account
GOV-FIN-002_desc: One-year accidental insurance scheme renewable from year to year offering coverage for accidental death and permanent disability at a nominal premium of ₹20 per year.
GOV-FIN-002_benefits: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability (loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet). ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability (loss of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot). Unmatched annual premium of just ₹20 per year
GOV-FIN-005_name: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons
GOV-FIN-005_desc: Tamil Nadu state government social security scheme granting monthly maintenance allowance to persons with severe disabilities, muscular dystrophy, and intellectual disabilities.
GOV-FIN-005_benefits: Monthly maintenance allowance of ₹2,000 per month (enhanced from ₹1,500) disbursed directly through DBT. Free bus passes and assistive devices support
GOV-FIN-006_desc: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers like street vendors, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, and agricultural laborers ensuring old age protection.
GOV-FIN-006_benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 on attaining age 60. 50% matching contribution paid by Central Government into beneficiary pension account. Family pension of 50% (₹1,500/month) to spouse upon subscriber's death
paramparagat-krishi-vikas_desc: Promotion of commercial organic farming through cluster formation and PGS certification.
paramparagat-krishi-vikas_benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare assistance over 3 years for organic inputs, certification, and direct marketing.
national-beekeeping-mission_desc: Promotion of scientific beekeeping to augment farmers' income, crop pollination, and honey production.
national-beekeeping-mission_benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on beehives, bee colonies, and honey extraction equipment for individuals and clusters.
mission-indradhanush_desc: Universal full immunization coverage for pregnant women and children up to 2 years against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases.
mission-indradhanush_benefits: Free vaccines protecting children and pregnant women against Tuberculosis, Polio, Measles, Hepatitis B, Tetanus, and Diphtheria.
rashtriya-arogya-nidhi_desc: One-time financial grant for poor patients suffering from major life-threatening diseases for treatment at government super-specialty hospitals.
rashtriya-arogya-nidhi_benefits: Financial grant up to ₹15 Lakh for life-saving medical treatment at AIIMS and central government tertiary hospitals.
tele-manas-mental-health_name: Tele MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
tele-manas-mental-health_desc: 24x7 toll-free comprehensive mental health counseling and psychiatric support across all Indian states in 20+ languages.
tele-manas-mental-health_benefits: 100% free confidential mental health consultation, crisis counseling, and referral to specialist psychiatric centers.
pm-svamitva-property-card_desc: Survey of villages and mapping with improvised technology in village areas to issue legal property ownership cards to rural owners.
pm-svamitva-property-card_benefits: Official Government Property Card enabling rural homeowners to use property as financial asset for taking bank loans and resolving disputes.
deendayal-antodaya-shelter_desc: Permanent all-weather community shelters with basic amenities for urban homeless populations across cities.
deendayal-antodaya-shelter_benefits: Free 24x7 night shelter with clean beds, drinking water, sanitation, lockers, healthcare checkups, and social security linkage.
affordable-rental-housing_desc: Ease of living for urban migrants and industrial workers through dignified affordable rental housing near workplaces.
affordable-rental-housing_benefits: Subsidized rental housing apartments with piped water, electricity, and security at low rents for urban workers.
